| 10‑11 May 2023 | **£1.125 million** | (reported as £1.031 million in 2022) | ✔ | ✔ |

- **Date of the auction:** **10‑11 May 2023** (held on the weekend 10th and 11th May 2023).  

The sale report (Brightwells — May 2023 Classic‑Car – Vintage Cars Auction) lists a total sales figure of **£1.125 m**, which is above the £1 million threshold. Comparing with the 2022 May auction, the 2023 figure was lower, satisfying the second criterion. No other 2023 Brightwells auction meets both criteria.

|--------------|-------------|------------------------|--------------|---------------|

The sale report (Brightwells — May 2023 Classic‑Car – Vintage Cars Auction) lists a total sales figure of **£1.125 m**, which is above the £1 million threshold.
